ryu.name: 疾风
ryu.identity: A young male ninja with the EXACT spiky navy-black hair, small SILVER forehead plate on a DARK headband, BLUE sleeveless wrap tunic, burgundy RED long scarf and waist sash, loose NAVY pants, WHITE wrist and calf wraps, dark fingerless gloves and dark open-toe ninja sandals in reference image 1. Same face and athletic build. NO white karate gi, NO red boxing gloves, NO bare feet, NO costume transformation. He uses empty-hand strikes; a small throwing star is allowed ONLY in the casting row; NEVER a long sword.

tank.name: 铁拳
tank.identity: A HUMAN heavyweight boxer, EXACT short black flat-top hair, tanned skin, exposed muscular BARE torso and shoulders, RED boxing gloves with white cuffs, rust RED baggy trousers, BLACK championship belt with a round GOLD medallion, BLACK lace-up boots with gold eyelets in reference image 1. Same face and stocky muscular build. NO helmet, NO visor, NO blue armour, NO robot, NO shirt, NO weapon. All attacks use boxing gloves, shoulders, knees or boots.

sage.name: 贤者
sage.identity: An adult male sorcerer with EXACT long flowing SILVER WHITE hair, pale skin and refined face, fitted PURPLE long coat with GOLD embroidery and trim, dark burgundy coat lining, BLACK belted pants, black fingerless gloves/bracers and BLACK GOLD-trimmed boots in reference image 1. Same face and slender build. EMPTY HANDS for all poses: NO staff, NO cane, NO sword, NO new equipment. He casts with his open palms.

groups.punch: TWO coherent 8-frame animations. Slots 0..7 in reading order (rows 1+2): quick forward jab/palm, sequence guard, windup, half extension, full CONTACT extension, contact hold, retract halfway, retract to guard, settled guard. Slots 8..15 (rows 3+4): heavy rear-hand palm/punch with hip rotation, same 8 stages. No sword in either sequence.
groups.kick: TWO coherent 8-frame animations. Slots 0..7 (rows 1+2) one standing forward kick: guard, knee chamber, half extension, full CONTACT, contact follow-through, knee retract, foot lowering, settled guard. Slots 8..15 (rows 3+4) one low sweep: lower body, crouch chamber, foot begins extension, fully extended low CONTACT, sweep follow-through, knee retract, rise halfway, settled guard. Do not mix unrelated attacks inside either 8-frame sequence.
groups.special: FOUR 4-frame rows. Row 1 projectile release: 1 wind-up hands pulled back, 2 FULL FORWARD RELEASE/CONTACT with extended arm, 3 retract, 4 return to identical standing guard. Row 2 rising attack: 1 low crouched preload, 2 full rising punch/open palm with one knee raised, 3 descending knees bent, 4 standing guard. Row 3 rush: 1 low loaded stance, 2 forward-leaning shoulder/palm impact, 3 low braking step, 4 standing guard. Row 4 grapple: 1 reaching forward to grab, 2 hip pivot and pulling throw gesture, 3 throwing follow-through, 4 return standing guard. No victim or other character. Empty hands except ninja may use a tiny shuriken in row 1. Do not draw any projectile, glow, elemental trail or impact effects.
groups.reaction: FOUR 4-frame rows. Row 1 HEAD HIT: first contact flinch, head and shoulders recoiling backwards, recovering balance, standing guard. Row 2 BODY HIT: first abdominal recoil, bent forwards holding torso, partially recovering, standing guard. Row 3 FALL: backward off-balance, airborne curl, low falling pose, lying flat on back on floor. Row 4 GET-UP: lying flat on back, propped up with arm, one-knee crouch, standing guard. ALL feet/bodies fit in their cells, same anatomy and head size including lying poses. No blood, no impact effects.
